task.description: WF-03 Step 4 run. Run the tests relevant to ISS-0930 in context.worktree and report real output: (1) `mix test test/letflow/scripts/` (whole scripts test dir, includes the new qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test.exs and seed_swiftroute_definition_test.exs); (2) any other test that reads test/fixtures/qa/ or scripts/seed_* (grep test/); (3) `mix format --check-formatted`; (4) `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` if not already compiled. The previous agent reported that the full `mix letflow.check.test` (16 partitions, then TEST_PARALLEL_N=4) failed on DB connection exhaustion / stalled and left Postgres with too_many_connections. FIRST check Postgres health (e.g. via the repo's documented DB access; see docs/anti-patterns.md for docker fallback) and whether orphaned beam/psql sessions from that run (command lines containing letflow-4-wf03-iss0930) still hold connections - terminate only those orphans (NOT processes from other sessions/worktrees, never the main checkout's). Then attempt `mix letflow.check.test` ONCE with modest parallelism (TEST_PARALLEL_N=2) under a hard timeout of 25 minutes; if it cannot complete for environmental reasons, say so plainly with evidence and report it as PARTIAL (CI on the PR will run the full suite as the authoritative gate) - do not loop. Do not modify files other than this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL; next_action 'Route to DOC-UPDATER / Step 5' on PASS or PARTIAL-with-targeted-green.
acceptance_criteria: Targeted tests run with real counts quoted
Full-suite attempt made once or environmental blocker evidenced

result.summary: Targeted tests, format, and compile all green. Full suite (TEST_PARALLEL_N=2) partition results are both all-pass, but the wrapper hit the 25-minute hard timeout (exit 124) before printing the aggregate, so it is reported PARTIAL per task rules. CI is the authoritative gate.
result.postgres_health: Used LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5482 (letflow-4-postgres-1, max_connections=100); worktree has no .env so default would be 5462 which is the sibling main-checkout container (79 connections from other sessions' letflow_test2/3/4; not touched). No beam/erl/mix/psql processes with command line containing letflow-4-wf03-iss0930 existed at start, so nothing to terminate. letflow-4-postgres-1 had 6 connections at start and 6 at end. No too_many_connections observed.
